journey.name: Home-screen widget
journey.description: The week widget: this week's workouts against the goal, the streak, and Workout and Lift buttons that start one as the launcher's shortcuts do, a workout already running kept. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval). The widget is placed from the launcher's widget picker (a long-press on the wallpaper, then Widgets, then Interval); the "This week" widget is the only one.

actions.action: Open the app, tap "Skip to Set up" on the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, then "Skip for now" on "Set up", go to Log, and set a weekly goal of 3 from its "Set a weekly goal" row
Open the Timer (the "Train" tab, "Conditioning", then "Timer"), start a workout, let a round finish, press the system back button and tap "End workout", then "Done" on the summary
Press Home, long-press the wallpaper, tap "Widgets" and find "Interval"

Verify that its "This week" widget is previewed drawn, with "3/5" in its ring, "2 to go" and "2-week streak" under it, and "Workout" and "Lift" buttons (Android 15 and up; the picker shows the app's icon before)
Place the widget at its offered size (two cells by two)
Verify that the widget shows "1/3" in its ring, "2 to go" under it, and "Workout" and "Lift" buttons
Tap "Workout" on the widget
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready" and "Round 1 of 8"
Press Home and tap "Lift" on the widget
Verify that the same workout is shown, still counting, and that adb shell dumpsys activity activities lists one MainActivity
Press the system back button and tap "End workout" in the dialog; if a round had finished by then, the summary shows first: tap "Done"
Press Home
Verify that the widget shows "2/3" and "1 to go" if the round had finished, else still "1/3"
Tap "Lift" on the widget
Verify that the session shows "Log set"
Press the system back button and tap "Leave" in the dialog, then press Home
End the app's process for a cold start (adb root, then adb shell kill -9 on its pid; not force-stop, after which Android's first tap only lifts the stopped state), then tap "Workout" on the widget
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready": the widget starts the app's container before it opens the workout
Press the system back button, tap "End workout", press Home, long-press the widget and resize it to two cells by one
Verify that the widget shows the ring with its figure and both buttons in one row
Resize it to four cells by two
Verify that the widget shows the ring, its words beside it, and the two buttons stacked on the right
